answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 1042 Country: India Title: i wanted to clafrify that i am doing a job in bank which is not an islamic bank, & my job is of customer service, means i am taking calls , talking with people over the handlng there queries which also includes of informing of interest charges sometimes, so i want to know whether these is cosidered as hallal or haram, once i get clarification from u i will decide to quit if it is haram. i request to reply for this mail. Question: asalamualaykum, i wanted to clafrify that i am doing a job in bank which is not an islamic bank, & my job is of customer service, means i am taking calls , talking with people over the handlng there queries which also includes of informing of interest charges sometimes, so i want to know whether these is cosidered as hallal or haram, once i get clarification from u i will decide to quit if it is haram. i request to reply for this mail. asalmualaykum Answer ID: 1042 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 513/502=N) The above mentioned work amounts to helping in interest transactions and helping someone in sin is also prohibited: لقولہ تعالی: ولا تعاونوا علی الاثم والعدوان واتقوا اللہ (الآیۃ) . Therefore, your job is not right. Moreover, generally the bank uses interest money for salary of the employees, if it is so then your earning is also unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
